main_text.head: ANNVS CHRISTI MDXXIV.
main_text.p: AD subvertendam Evangelii doctrinam omnes hoc anno machinas adhibebant politici æquè ac Ecclesiastici.

E Politicis, Cæsar, Imperii Principes in conventu Norico, Ferdinandus, solus, & cum confœderatis, Henricus VIII. Rex Angliæ, Ludovicus Rex Ungariæ & Boëmiæ: Duces, Bavarus & Lotharingus: Metenses, Diethmarsi, Antuerpiani, Duodecim deniq; Pagi Helvetiorum, in opprimendo Evangelio toti fuerunt.Sleidanus.
CÆSAR per Joannem Haunartum Principibus mandat: ut edictum VVormatiense de exterminandis Lutheranis magno studio servent.

PRINCIPES Imperii Noribergæ congregati, se, quantum eius præstare possint, facturos pollicentur.Acta Conventus Norici. Quod ubi Lutherus rescivit, dentato scripto de Germaniæ cæcitate conquestus est, oblatam sibi salutem repudiantis.
FERDINANDI Austrii permissu Viennæ Caspar Tauberus civis Viennensis, constans Christi confessor, capite truncatur, mense Septembri.Martyrologium Rabi. Idem

page.notes: Marginal notes read: "Sleidanus." beside the second paragraph; "Acta Conventus Norici." beside the fourth; "Martyrologium Rabi." beside the fifth. The word "Idem" at the line end is a catchword-like line and is kept in the text. Some letters in the scan are damaged (e.g. "Diethmarsi", "Antuerpiani") and read as printed. The "Digitized by Google" banner at the bottom right is omitted.
